_doc: Model intelligence + salary DB (v3). Salaries DERIVED FROM REAL QUOTA. opencode has FOUR independent pools: openrouter_free(shared w/ cline,aider), gemini_direct(Google AI Studio), cohere_trial, openai(dead). agy own quota. Orchestrator enforces BETWEEN dispatches; the POOL quota is the hard wall.

cost_model._doc: cost_salary_usd is now ENFORCED in economy.mjs: isEligible() applies a dollar wall per model (stops when ledger.costs[id] >= cost_salary_usd), and spend() accumulates --cost into ledger.costs. Origin: termonster usage.jsonl, where cacheWrite dominates cost (observed: opus 'hi' = $0.30 from 30411 cacheWrite tokens). termonster itself has been removed from the box; only this cost model and the economy.mjs wall remain.
cost_model.proposed_enforcement: canAfford(): also stop when sum(ledger.costs[model]) >= model.cost_salary_usd (optional, per-model)
